tests: [elementhandle.test] ElementHandle specs ElementHandle.boxModel should work
[elementhandle.test] ElementHandle specs ElementHandle.boxModel should return null for invisible elements
[elementhandle.test] ElementHandle specs ElementHandle.boxModel should correctly compute box model with offsets
reason: Reads the box model, four quads of content, padding, border and margin with the element's width and height. Strider's `Locator.boundingBox` gives one rectangle, and no row covers quads; `method-elementhandle-boundingbox` is the nearest, the handle's box, which is missing as well

tests: [elementhandle.test] ElementHandle specs ElementHandle.clickablePoint should work
[elementhandle.test] ElementHandle specs ElementHandle.clickablePoint should not work if the click box is not visible
[elementhandle.test] ElementHandle specs ElementHandle.clickablePoint should not work if the click box is not visible due to the iframe
[elementhandle.test] ElementHandle specs ElementHandle.clickablePoint should work for iframes
reason: Returns the point a click lands on, in page coordinates, and fails when the element's click box is outside the viewport. Strider has no point read: its clicks choose the point internally and report nothing. `method-elementhandle-click` is the nearest row, the click whose point this reads

tests: [elementhandle.test] ElementHandle specs ElementHandle.touchStart should work
[elementhandle.test] ElementHandle specs ElementHandle.touchStart should work with the returned Touch
[elementhandle.test] ElementHandle specs ElementHandle.touchMove should work
[elementhandle.test] ElementHandle specs ElementHandle.touchMove should work with a pre-existing Touch
[elementhandle.test] ElementHandle specs ElementHandle.touchEnd should work
reason: Starts, moves and ends touches on an element or at points, and holds them between steps. Strider has no touchscreen: `Locator.tap` sends one tap, and nothing starts, moves or ends a touch on its own

tests: [elementhandle.test] ElementHandle specs ElementHandle.isVisible and ElementHandle.isHidden should not throw for a detached text node with no parent element
[elementhandle.test] ElementHandle specs ElementHandle.isVisible and ElementHandle.isHidden should use the shadow host for a text node placed directly in a shadow root
[elementhandle.test] ElementHandle specs ElementHandle.click should not work for TextNodes
[elementhandle.test] ElementHandle specs ElementHandle.toElement should work
decision: Playwright is evidence, not the template
reason: Targets a handle to a text node, which a locator can't select (locators select elements), and casts a handle to an element type (`toElement`). Strider's JSHandle has no cast, and `method-jshandle-aselement` is the nearest row

tests: [elementhandle.test] ElementHandle specs Element.waitForSelector should wait correctly with waitForSelector and xpath on an element
reason: Waits for an XPath query inside an element, `xpath/.//div`. Locators accept CSS only; XPath is planned for 1.0 and has no form yet

tests: [elementhandle.test] ElementHandle specs Custom queries should register and unregister
[elementhandle.test] ElementHandle specs Custom queries should throw with invalid query names
[elementhandle.test] ElementHandle specs Custom queries should work for multiple elements
[elementhandle.test] ElementHandle specs Custom queries should eval correctly
[elementhandle.test] ElementHandle specs Custom queries should wait correctly with waitForSelector
[elementhandle.test] ElementHandle specs Custom queries should wait correctly with waitForSelector on an element
[elementhandle.test] ElementHandle specs Custom queries should work when both queryOne and queryAll are registered
[elementhandle.test] ElementHandle specs Custom queries should eval when both queryOne and queryAll are registered
[elementhandle.test] ElementHandle specs Custom queries should work with function shorthands
reason: Registers named query handlers (`getById/foo`) that page.$, $$, $eval and waitForSelector then use, and unregisters them. Strider has no custom selector registry, so there is nothing to register a query with; the matrix row says so

tests: [elementhandle.test] ElementHandle specs ElementHandle.dispose should dispose cached isolated handler
reason: Tests Puppeteer's own bookkeeping: the isolated-world handle its click caches and that `dispose` then disposes (spied with sinon). Strider's handles keep no such cache; they are released with `JSHandle.release` and Effect scopes

tests: [elementhandle.test] ElementHandle specs ElementHandle[Symbol.dispose] should work
[elementhandle.test] ElementHandle specs ElementHandle[Symbol.asyncDispose] should work
[elementhandle.test] ElementHandle specs ElementHandle.move should work
reason: Disposes a handle with JavaScript's `using`, `await using`, or `move()`, which transfers it to a new handle. Strider's JSHandle has `release` and no disposal protocol, and handles are released with their scope; the matrix row for the disposal protocol is the nearest

elements
reason: Clicks through a locator, which needs `input.native`, and stock WebKit's inspector protocol has no Input domain (the adapter refuses it Unsupported), so the click fails before the test's own checks run

tests: [elementhandle.test] ElementHandle specs ElementHandle.hover should work
reason: Hovers through a locator, which needs `input.native`; stock WebKit's inspector protocol has no Input domain, so the hover fails Unsupported
